```{r}
##Import data
ILT_CFU_Count <- read.csv("~/Documents/DeQueen_Litter/ILT_CFU_Count.csv")

```

```{r}
##Visualize and run stats
# ==============================================================
# ILT CFU Count — ANOVA + Tukey CLD + visualization
# Dose-response modeling will be handled separately later
# ==============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(multcompView)

# ==============================================================
# 1. Pivot to long format + clean treatment names
# ==============================================================

ILT_long <- ILT_CFU_Count %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Target, Day, Replicate),
    names_to = "Treatment_raw",
    values_to = "Log10"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = dplyr::case_when(
      Treatment_raw == "Media.Control"    ~ "MCT",
      Treatment_raw == "Bacteria.Control" ~ "BCT",
      grepl("^ILT", Treatment_raw) ~ gsub("ILT\\.|\\.$", "", Treatment_raw),
      TRUE ~ Treatment_raw
    ),
    Treatment = dplyr::recode(
      Treatment,
      "0.75" = "0.75%",
      "1.5"  = "1.5%",
      "3"    = "3%",
      "6"    = "6%",
      "12"   = "12%",
      "24"   = "24%"
    ),
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("MCT", "BCT", "0.75%", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    ),
    Day = factor(Day, levels = sort(unique(Day))),
    Target_label = dplyr::recode(
      as.character(Target),
      "E. cecorum" = "*E. cecorum*",
      "E. hirae"   = "*E. hirae*"
    ),
    Target_label = factor(
      Target_label,
      levels = c("*E. cecorum*", "*E. hirae*")
    )
  )

# ==============================================================
# 2. Summary stats
# ==============================================================

ILT_summary <- ILT_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target, Target_label, Day, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean = mean(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = dplyr::n(),
    SEM  = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ==============================================================
# 3. One-way ANOVA by Target x Day
# ==============================================================

ILT_anova_results <- ILT_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target, Target_label, Day) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    out <- summary(fit)[[1]]

    data.frame(
      df_treatment = out["Treatment", "Df"],
      df_residual  = out["Residuals", "Df"],
      F_value      = out["Treatment", "F value"],
      p_value      = out["Treatment", "Pr(>F)"]
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

cat("\n=== ANOVA results ===\n")
print(ILT_anova_results)

# ==============================================================
# 4. Pairwise t-tests by Target x Day
# ==============================================================

ILT_pairwise_ttest_results <- ILT_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target, Day) %>%
  dplyr::group_split() %>%
  setNames(
    ILT_long %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Target, Day) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(name = paste(Target, Day, sep = " | Day ")) %>%
      dplyr::pull(name)
  ) %>%
  lapply(function(df) {
    pairwise.t.test(
      x = df$Log10,
      g = df$Treatment,
      p.adjust.method = "none",
      pool.sd = FALSE
    )
  })

cat("\n=== Pairwise t-test results ===\n")
print(ILT_pairwise_ttest_results)

# ==============================================================
# 5. Tukey HSD + CLD letters by Target x Day
# ==============================================================

ILT_cld <- ILT_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target, Target_label, Day) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    tuk <- TukeyHSD(fit)
    cld <- multcompView::multcompLetters4(fit, tuk)

    data.frame(
      Treatment = names(cld$Treatment$Letters),
      CLD = cld$Treatment$Letters,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("MCT", "BCT", "0.75%", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ILT_summary,
    by = c("Target", "Target_label", "Day", "Treatment")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_pos = Mean + SEM + 0.4
  )

# ==============================================================
# 6. Treatment fill colors
# ==============================================================

biofilm_fills <- c(
  "MCT"   = "grey85",
  "BCT"   = "grey45",
  "0.75%" = "#fcfdbf",
  "1.5%"  = "#febb81",
  "3%"    = "#f8765c",
  "6%"    = "#d3436e",
  "12%"   = "#982d80",
  "24%"   = "#221150"
)

# ==============================================================
# 7. Plot
# ==============================================================

p_ILT_CFU <- ggplot(
  ILT_summary,
  aes(x = Treatment, y = Mean, fill = Treatment)
) +
  geom_col(
    color = "black",
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SEM, ymax = Mean + SEM),
    width = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = ILT_long,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = Log10),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.4,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.9,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = ILT_cld,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = y_pos, label = CLD),
    size = 2.6,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = -0.35,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(Target_label),
    cols = vars(Day),
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = biofilm_fills, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(bold(Log[10]~CFU/mL))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 10, color = "white", face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "white", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = "black")
  )

print(p_ILT_CFU)

# ==============================================================
# 9. Save
# ==============================================================

png("mic_lot.png", width = 7, height = 4, units = "in", res = 900)
print(p_ILT_CFU)
dev.off()

```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# ILT CFU Count — % growth inhibition plot with CLDs + ANOVA p
# Bars/points show % inhibition relative to BCT
# CLDs and ANOVA p-values are based on Log10 CFU/mL
# ==============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(ggh4x)
library(multcompView)

# ==============================================================
# 1. Long format + clean treatments
# ==============================================================

ILT_growth_long <- ILT_CFU_Count %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Target, Day, Replicate),
    names_to = "Treatment_raw",
    values_to = "Log10"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = dplyr::case_when(
      Treatment_raw == "Media.Control"    ~ "MCT",
      Treatment_raw == "Bacteria.Control" ~ "BCT",
      grepl("^ILT", Treatment_raw) ~ gsub("ILT\\.|\\.$", "", Treatment_raw),
      TRUE ~ Treatment_raw
    ),
    Treatment = dplyr::recode(
      Treatment,
      "0.75" = "0.75%",
      "1.5"  = "1.5%",
      "3"    = "3%",
      "6"    = "6%",
      "12"   = "12%",
      "24"   = "24%"
    ),
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("MCT", "BCT", "0.75%", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    ),
    Day = factor(
      Day,
      levels = sort(unique(Day)),
      labels = paste("Day", sort(unique(Day)))
    ),
    Target_label = dplyr::recode(
      as.character(Target),
      "E. cecorum" = "E. cecorum",
      "E. hirae"   = "E. hirae"
    ),
    Target_label = factor(
      Target_label,
      levels = c("E. cecorum", "E. hirae")
    )
  )

# ==============================================================
# 2. Calculate % growth inhibition relative to BCT
# ==============================================================

ILT_bct_lookup <- ILT_growth_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment == "BCT") %>%
  dplyr::select(Target, Day, Replicate, BCT_Log10 = Log10)

ILT_growth_inhibition <- ILT_growth_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment != "MCT") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ILT_bct_lookup,
    by = c("Target", "Day", "Replicate")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Growth_inhibition = ((BCT_Log10 - Log10) / BCT_Log10) * 100,
    Growth_inhibition = pmax(0, pmin(100, Growth_inhibition))
  )

# ==============================================================
# 3. Summary for bars
# ==============================================================

ILT_growth_summary <- ILT_growth_inhibition %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target, Target_label, Day, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean = mean(Growth_inhibition, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Growth_inhibition, na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = dplyr::n(),
    SEM  = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ==============================================================
# 4. ANOVA p-values on Log10 CFU/mL
# ==============================================================

fmt_p_rich <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("<i>p</i> = NA")
  if (p < 0.01) {
    sprintf("<i>p</i> = %s", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1))
  } else {
    sprintf("<i>p</i> = %.2f", p)
  }
}

ILT_anova_labels <- ILT_growth_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment != "MCT") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target, Target_label, Day) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    out <- summary(fit)[[1]]

    data.frame(
      anova_p = out["Treatment", "Pr(>F)"]
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    P_Label = paste0("ANOVA ", vapply(anova_p, fmt_p_rich, character(1))),
    x_lab = 0.65,
    y_lab = Inf
  )

# ==============================================================
# 5. Tukey HSD CLDs on Log10 CFU/mL
# ==============================================================

ILT_growth_cld <- ILT_growth_long %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment != "MCT") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target, Target_label, Day) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    tuk <- TukeyHSD(fit)
    cld <- multcompView::multcompLetters4(fit, tuk)

    data.frame(
      Treatment = names(cld$Treatment$Letters),
      CLD = cld$Treatment$Letters,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("BCT", "0.75%", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ILT_growth_summary,
    by = c("Target", "Target_label", "Day", "Treatment")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_pos = Mean + SEM + 5
  )

# ==============================================================
# 6. Colors
# ==============================================================

biofilm_fills <- c(
  "BCT"   = "grey45",
  "0.75%" = "#fcfdbf",
  "1.5%"  = "#febb81",
  "3%"    = "#f8765c",
  "6%"    = "#d3436e",
  "12%"   = "#982d80",
  "24%"   = "#221150"
)

# ==============================================================
# 7. Italic facet labels
# ==============================================================

target_labeller <- as_labeller(
  c(
    "E. cecorum" = "*E. cecorum*",
    "E. hirae"   = "*E. hirae*"
  )
)

# ==============================================================
# 8. Plot
# ==============================================================

p_ILT_growth_inhibition <- ggplot(
  ILT_growth_summary,
  aes(x = Treatment, y = Mean, fill = Treatment)
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 50,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_col(
    color = "black",
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SEM, ymax = Mean + SEM),
    width = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = ILT_growth_inhibition,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = Growth_inhibition),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.4,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.9,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = ILT_growth_cld,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = y_pos, label = CLD),
    size = 2.6,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = -0.35,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(
    data = ILT_anova_labels,
    aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, label = P_Label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 2,
    size = 2.5,
    fill = NA,
    label.colour = NA,
    label.padding = unit(0, "lines")
  ) +
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(Day),
    cols = vars(Target_label),
    scales = "free",
    independent = "all",
    labeller = labeller(Target_label = target_labeller)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = biofilm_fills, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.18))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "% growth inhibition"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 10, color = "white", face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "white", face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = "black")
  )

print(p_ILT_growth_inhibition)

png("mic_inhibition_plot.png", width = 4.5, height = 6.5, units = "in", res = 900)
print(p_ILT_growth_inhibition)
dev.off()

```

```{r}
##plot of log10 values for supplemental figure
##mimics structure above

# ==============================================================
# ILT CFU Count — Log10 CFU/mL supplemental plot with CLDs + ANOVA p
# Same aesthetics/layout as % growth inhibition plot
# CLDs and ANOVA p-values are based on Log10 CFU/mL
# ==============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(ggh4x)
library(multcompView)

# ==============================================================
# 1. Long format + clean treatments
# ==============================================================

ILT_log10_long <- ILT_CFU_Count %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Target, Day, Replicate),
    names_to = "Treatment_raw",
    values_to = "Log10"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = dplyr::case_when(
      Treatment_raw == "Media.Control"    ~ "MCT",
      Treatment_raw == "Bacteria.Control" ~ "BCT",
      grepl("^ILT", Treatment_raw) ~ gsub("ILT\\.|\\.$", "", Treatment_raw),
      TRUE ~ Treatment_raw
    ),
    Treatment = dplyr::recode(
      Treatment,
      "0.75" = "0.75%",
      "1.5"  = "1.5%",
      "3"    = "3%",
      "6"    = "6%",
      "12"   = "12%",
      "24"   = "24%"
    ),
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("MCT", "BCT", "0.75%", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    ),
    Day = factor(
      Day,
      levels = sort(unique(Day)),
      labels = paste("Day", sort(unique(Day)))
    ),
    Target_label = dplyr::recode(
      as.character(Target),
      "E. cecorum" = "E. cecorum",
      "E. hirae"   = "E. hirae"
    ),
    Target_label = factor(
      Target_label,
      levels = c("E. cecorum", "E. hirae")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment != "MCT")

# ==============================================================
# 2. Summary for bars
# ==============================================================

ILT_log10_summary <- ILT_log10_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target, Target_label, Day, Treatment) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean = mean(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = dplyr::n(),
    SEM  = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ==============================================================
# 3. ANOVA p-values on Log10 CFU/mL
# ==============================================================

fmt_p_rich <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("<i>p</i> = NA")
  if (p < 0.01) {
    sprintf("<i>p</i> = %s", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1))
  } else {
    sprintf("<i>p</i> = %.2f", p)
  }
}

ILT_log10_anova_labels <- ILT_log10_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target, Target_label, Day) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    out <- summary(fit)[[1]]

    data.frame(
      anova_p = out["Treatment", "Pr(>F)"]
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    P_Label = paste0("ANOVA ", vapply(anova_p, fmt_p_rich, character(1))),
    x_lab = 0.65,
    y_lab = Inf
  )

# ==============================================================
# 4. Tukey HSD CLDs on Log10 CFU/mL
# ==============================================================

ILT_log10_cld <- ILT_log10_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target, Target_label, Day) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    tuk <- TukeyHSD(fit)
    cld <- multcompView::multcompLetters4(fit, tuk)

    data.frame(
      Treatment = names(cld$Treatment$Letters),
      CLD = cld$Treatment$Letters,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("BCT", "0.75%", "1.5%", "3%", "6%", "12%", "24%")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    ILT_log10_summary,
    by = c("Target", "Target_label", "Day", "Treatment")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y_pos = Mean + SEM + 0.35
  )

# ==============================================================
# 5. Colors
# ==============================================================

biofilm_fills <- c(
  "BCT"   = "grey45",
  "0.75%" = "#fcfdbf",
  "1.5%"  = "#febb81",
  "3%"    = "#f8765c",
  "6%"    = "#d3436e",
  "12%"   = "#982d80",
  "24%"   = "#221150"
)

# ==============================================================
# 6. Italic facet labels
# ==============================================================

target_labeller <- as_labeller(
  c(
    "E. cecorum" = "*E. cecorum*",
    "E. hirae"   = "*E. hirae*"
  )
)

# ==============================================================
# 7. Plot
# ==============================================================

p_ILT_log10_CFU <- ggplot(
  ILT_log10_summary,
  aes(x = Treatment, y = Mean, fill = Treatment)
) +
  geom_col(
    color = "black",
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SEM, ymax = Mean + SEM),
    width = 0.3,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = ILT_log10_long,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = Log10),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.4,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.9,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = ILT_log10_cld,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = y_pos, label = CLD),
    size = 2.6,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = -0.6,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(
    data = ILT_log10_anova_labels,
    aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, label = P_Label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 2,
    size = 2.5,
    fill = NA,
    label.colour = NA,
    label.padding = unit(0, "lines")
  ) +
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(Day),
    cols = vars(Target_label),
    scales = "free_y",
    independent = "y",
    labeller = labeller(Target_label = target_labeller)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = biofilm_fills, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.35))  #increased top expansion
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(bold(Log[10]~CFU/mL))
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

print(p_ILT_log10_CFU)

png("mic_log10_cfu_plot.png", width = 4.5, height = 6.5, units = "in", res = 900)
print(p_ILT_log10_CFU)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
##Pull info for results section

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(broom)

# ==============================================================
# 6. Summary: Log10 CFU/mL, % inhibition, and fold-change vs BCT
# ==============================================================

ILT_bct_summary <- ILT_growth_long %>%
  filter(Treatment == "BCT") %>%
  group_by(Target, Target_label, Day) %>%
  summarise(
    BCT_mean_log10 = mean(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ILT_mic_summary <- ILT_growth_inhibition %>%
  filter(Treatment != "BCT") %>%
  group_by(Target, Target_label, Day, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log10 = mean(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_log10   = sd(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = dplyr::n(),
    sem_log10  = sd_log10 / sqrt(n),

    mean_inhibition = mean(Growth_inhibition, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_inhibition   = sd(Growth_inhibition, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_inhibition  = sd_inhibition / sqrt(n),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    ILT_bct_summary,
    by = c("Target", "Target_label", "Day")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log10_reduction_vs_BCT = BCT_mean_log10 - mean_log10,
    fold_reduction_vs_BCT  = 10^log10_reduction_vs_BCT
  ) %>%
  arrange(Target_label, Day, Treatment)

print(ILT_mic_summary, n = Inf)


# ==============================================================
# 7. BCT summary for reference
# ==============================================================

ILT_bct_reference <- ILT_growth_long %>%
  filter(Treatment == "BCT") %>%
  group_by(Target, Target_label, Day, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_log10 = mean(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_log10   = sd(Log10, na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = dplyr::n(),
    sem_log10  = sd_log10 / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Target_label, Day)

print(ILT_bct_reference, n = Inf)


# ==============================================================
# 8. Full ANOVA output on Log10 CFU/mL
# ==============================================================

ILT_anova_full <- ILT_growth_long %>%
  filter(Treatment != "MCT") %>%
  group_by(Target, Target_label, Day) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)

    broom::tidy(fit) %>%
      filter(term == "Treatment") %>%
      transmute(
        df_treatment = df,
        df_residual  = fit$df.residual,
        F_value      = statistic,
        p_value      = p.value
      )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Target_label, Day)

print(ILT_anova_full, n = Inf)


# ==============================================================
# 9. Tukey HSD pairwise p values on Log10 CFU/mL
# ==============================================================

ILT_tukey_pairwise <- ILT_growth_long %>%
  filter(Treatment != "MCT") %>%
  group_by(Target, Target_label, Day) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    fit <- aov(Log10 ~ Treatment, data = .x)
    tuk <- TukeyHSD(fit)$Treatment

    as.data.frame(tuk) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("contrast") %>%
      rename(
        diff_log10 = diff,
        lower_ci   = lwr,
        upper_ci   = upr,
        p_adj      = `p adj`
      )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Target_label, Day, p_adj)

print(ILT_tukey_pairwise, n = Inf)


# ==============================================================
# 10. Only pairwise comparisons versus BCT
# ==============================================================

ILT_tukey_vs_BCT <- ILT_tukey_pairwise %>%
  filter(grepl("BCT", contrast)) %>%
  arrange(Target_label, Day, p_adj)

print(ILT_tukey_vs_BCT, n = Inf)
```
